say:1:1511228001:1.text: Oh, I'm healed... I thought I was going to die today.

say:8:1511228007:0.text: It was nothing. We're actually here to inquire about something.
say:8:1511228007:0.source_cn: 无妨，我们只是想来打听一些事。

say:10:1511228009:0.source_cn: 许多人都说理想乡距离这里很远。那些纸一定是之前待在这里...

say:12:1511228010:0.text: *Cough*... I wish Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> was still around. Then, nobody would go looking for Utopia.

say:23:1511228019:1.text: When I returned, I heard that Nazrik could no longer stomach Kordan's actions. He left alone years ago and severed all ties with the Wildborn.

say:24:1511228020:1.text: If the goddess' spear were still around, we could try to find him. But he left nothing behind.

say:25:1511228021:1.text: Nazrik once said that he would aim his spear at all the enemies of the Wildborn. Yet now some within the tribe consider each other enemies.
say:25:1511228021:1.source_cn: 那非说过，为了雅库伯尔，他会将投矛对准敌人。可是，雅库...

say:26:1511228022:1.text: He refused to spill the blood of his kin, and so he chose exile.
say:26:1511228022:1.source_cn: 他拒绝让自己人流血，所以他选择离开。风总会吹向另一片丛林。

say:27:1511228023:1.text: What a pity. I was actually hoping he'd become the next chief.
say:27:1511228023:1.source_cn: 多可惜啊。俺原本还盼着他当下任首领呢。

say:28:1511228024:1.text: Kordan would not like hearing that.
say:28:1511228024:1.source_cn: 唉……戈丹不喜欢听到这些。

say:29:1511228025:1.text: Bah, I don't care! I'm too old to take Kordan down myself, but he's gone soft with age too. Mark my words, someone younger will step up. It's time for new blood to lead!

say:32:1511228028:0.source_cn: 又有人跑去封印之地了，不能再这样下去，我们得找到传言的源头。
